# BepInEx.ConfigDrawers

> BepInEx.ConfigDrawers is in-game configuration manager for bepinex plugins featuring docking drawers, data tables, and syntax-highlighted config file editing. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Generic game-agnostic BepInEx configuration UI framework**: Generic game-agnostic BepInEx configuration UI framework.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal drawer factories or reflection helpers**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal drawer factories or reflection helpers.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/BepInEx.ConfigDrawers/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
